newsitem.title: PERU: Mining stocks give Lima bolsa small gain by finish.
newsitem.headline: Mining stocks give Lima bolsa small gain by finish.

text.p: Shares on the Lima stock exchange closed slightly stronger Monday in modest volume as investors bought leading mining stocks but sold other blue chips.
They added the market would likely rise Tuesday as players expected January's year-on-year gross domestic product figure to be healthy. The figure is due out later today.
The General Index rose Monday 0.31 percent to 1,678.16 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index climbed 0.27 percent to 2,423.62 points.
In a total of 1,812 trades, volume was 24.0 million soles ($9.1 million), according to preliminary figures.
"Despite corrections in most blue chips, the mining sector provided the impetus for the session's rise," said Lorenzo Wong of local brokerage Intercapital.
Southern Peru Limited outperformed the market, closing up 2.91 percent at $17.30 on volume of 40,300 shares.
Polymetal miner Atacocha closed up 3.96 percent at 1.05 soles on 545,000 shares.
After last week's strong gains, some leaders fell back slightly Monday.

Benchmark Telefnica del Per B rose 0.82 percent to 6.08 soles in volume of 901,000 shares. Backus y Johnston, the country's largest brewery, rose 1.16 percent to 2.56 soles in volume of 650,000 shares.
